title: This Anthropic Hackathon Winner Just Released His Entire Claude Code Setup for Free - ECC
description:
Comment "HUMAN" and I'll send you the ebook. 🔥

The Anthropic Hackathon Winner Just Released His Entire Claude Code Setup for Free

It's called Everything Claude Code (ECC)

64 specialized AI agents. 262 skills. 84 slash commands. Pre-built MCP configs for GitHub, Supabase, Vercel, and Railway. All wired together from day one.

It even reads your Git history, spots your coding patterns, and turns them into reusable skills automatically. The longer you use it the smarter it gets.

This is not a starter template. This is the setup that won a hackathon.

Save this before you forget.

#claude #aitools #prompts #artificialintelligence #chatgpt
